extracted_concepts.name: 二次型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: n元二次齐次多项式 f(x₁,...,xₙ)=Σaᵢⱼxᵢxⱼ

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵表示
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f = x^T A x，其中A是对称矩阵

extracted_concepts.name: 对称矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 二次型矩阵形式中A为对称矩阵

extracted_concepts.name: 合同变换
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 通过非退化线性替换x=Cy将二次型化为标准形

extracted_concepts.name: 非退化线性替换
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x = Cy，C可逆的线性替换

extracted_concepts.name: 标准形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f = λ₁y₁²+λ₂y₂²+...+λₙyₙ²

extracted_concepts.name: 正定二次型
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 对所有非零向量x，f = x^T A x > 0

extracted_concepts.name: 正定矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 对所有非零x有x^T A x > 0的矩阵A

extracted_concepts.name: 特征值
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 矩阵A的特征值，标准形系数即特征值

extracted_concepts.name: 特征向量
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 对应于每个特征值的特征向量

extracted_concepts.name: 顺序主子式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A的所有顺序主子式都大于0可判定正定

extracted_concepts.name: 主子式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A的所有主子式都大于0可判定正定

extracted_concepts.name: 正交矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 满足Q^T Q = I的矩阵Q

extracted_concepts.name: 实对称矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 一定可以正交对角化的实对称矩阵A

extracted_concepts.name: 正交对角化
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 存在正交矩阵Q使得A = QΛQ^T

extracted_concepts.name: 对角矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Λ为对角矩阵，A = QΛQ^T

extracted_concepts.name: Gram-Schmidt正交化
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 将特征向量正交化的过程

extracted_concepts.name: 单位化
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 将正交化后的向量单位化

extracted_concepts.name: 逆矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 正交矩阵满足Q⁻¹ = Q^T

extracted_concepts.name: 转置矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Q^T，正交矩阵定义Q^T Q = I中使用
